description: Every format limit of HyperSVG 2.0, in one place (9.8). Each limit has its value, its unit, its class, the section that states it and its reason. A capacity limit with upTo may be raised: a host profile's limits say how far that host lets content go, and an experience's limits say how far it needs to go (9.8.1). A safety limit never changes. Budgets (A10.3) may still be stricter than any of these. The grammars mark each limited node with x-hsvg-limit and the limit id; check-limits.mjs proves that every marked node, every svgLimits value and every text phrase says the value written here. To change a value: the person decides, DECISIONS.md records it, then set-limit.mjs writes it everywhere. why gives the reason; whyRecorded is true when the spec or a ruling states it, false when it is the most likely reason, written down on 7 November 2026 for the person to confirm. checkedBy says what enforces it today: schema (the generated schemas), drawing-check, checker (engine/v2/check), engine (while playing).

classes.capacity: How big or rich an experience may be. Raisable when upTo is given; otherwise fixed, and why says why.
classes.safety: Stops runaway content (loops, runaway formulas, deep nesting). Never raised.

liveTimers.says: Live timers and timed links per experience; one more faults with E-EVENT-LOOP.
liveTimers.why: A timer that starts timers is a loop.

eventsPerTransaction.why: Events that raise events without end are a loop.

markerCrossingsPerMs.says: Crossings of one clip's markers at one engine millisecond; one more is E-EVENT-LOOP.
markerCrossingsPerMs.why: Only a runaway clip (a very high speed on a short loop) crosses this many; markers are deadlines, so step size never changes them (6.7).

text.phrase: | Marker crossings of one clip at one engine millisecond | {} |

formulaStepsPerTransaction.says: Formula evaluation steps in one transaction, all formulas together.

formulaSource.says: The source of one formula or template.

formulaSteps.says: Work steps of one evaluation (5.6.6): nodes evaluated, rows visited, items sorted or compared, and every 16 items or characters copied or read.
formulaSteps.why: Bounds the work of one formula, so no formula can freeze or exhaust the page; 65536 is 64 steps for each of 1024 rows, so a row formula reads the largest table. Measured: at most about 100 ns a step, so one evaluation stays under about 7 ms.

attachActionsPerBlock.why: The checker proves every attach reachable and safe; this bounds that proof.

seats.why: Turn order, views and legal moves are worked out per seat.
